repos.name: openship
repos.description: Self-hosted deployment platform
repos.summary: Openship is an open-source platform that helps you deploy and manage your software projects. It automatically detects your project's setup, builds it, and handles configurations for databases, domains, and other infrastructure needs. You can interact with Openship through a desktop app, a web dashboard, or a command-line interface.

repos.name: ai-agent-book
repos.description: 《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》（李博杰 著）开源主仓库：全书正文、编译版 PDF 与按章配套代码
repos.summary: This project is an open-source book titled "In-depth Understanding of AI Agents: Design Principles and Engineering Practices." It explains AI agents, which are defined as a combination of large language models (LLMs), context, and tools. The book covers the design and practical engineering of these agents, offering the full text, compiled PDFs, and accompanying code for each chapter.

repos.name: topcoat
repos.description: A batteries-included framework for building web apps
repos.summary: Topcoat is a framework for building web applications using the Rust programming language. It allows developers to create full-stack applications, meaning both the user interface and the server-side logic can be handled within the same project. This framework aims to simplify the development process by providing a set of tools and features that work together.

repos.name: Ontology-Playground
repos.description: Free, open-source web app for learning about ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies, design your own visually, export as RDF/XML, and share interactive diagrams. Zero backend, fully static.
repos.summary: Ontology Playground is a free, open-source web application that helps users learn about ontologies, which are ways of organizing knowledge. It allows users to explore pre-built ontologies, design their own visually, and export them in a specific format. The application also provides interactive diagrams and a learning hub with courses and quizzes.

repos.name: wigolo
repos.description: The go-to web for your AI coding agent — local-first search, fetch, crawl & research over MCP. No API keys, no cloud, $0/query. Public beta.
repos.summary: Wigolo provides AI coding agents with a way to interact with the web locally. It allows agents to search, fetch, crawl, and research information without needing API keys or relying on cloud services, meaning there is no cost per query. This project works with various coding agents and development tools.

repos.name: 3x-ui
repos.summary: This project runs a web panel and network connections using a single port. Normally, the web panel and network connections would each need their own port, but this project uses an Nginx reverse proxy to manage both through the single port provided by Railway. This allows both the web panel for managing settings and the network connections for users to be accessible at the same time.

repos.name: yoinks
repos.description: yoink any video from your terminal. no shady ads.
repos.summary: This project is a tool that lets you download videos from over 1,800 websites, including YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram, Threads, and TikTok, directly from your terminal. You paste a web address (URL), choose a video quality or an audio-only MP3 option, and the tool downloads the file without any advertisements or fake buttons. It saves the downloaded files to your Downloads folder and shows you the file's location when it's finished.

repos.name: adhd
repos.description: ADHD — a skill for coding agents. Tree-of-thought with pruning, built on the Claude & Codex Agent SDK. Fans out parallel divergent thoughts under different cognitive frames, scores, prunes traps, deepens the survivors. The no-brainer skill for creative and interdisciplinary work.
repos.summary: ADHD is a skill for coding agents that helps them generate more creative and interdisciplinary ideas. It works by spawning multiple parallel reasoning processes, each exploring the problem from a different perspective, and then scoring, filtering, and deepening the most promising ideas. This approach is designed to avoid premature convergence and uncover a wider range of solutions.

repos.name: MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize
repos.description: MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize 0.9B is an open-source SOTA end-to-end audio understanding model for long-form multi-speaker transcription, diarization, timestamps, and acoustic event awareness.
repos.summary: MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize is a model that understands audio. It takes long audio recordings with multiple speakers and turns them into text transcripts. This process includes identifying who is speaking and when they start and stop talking, providing precise timestamps for each segment. The model can also identify acoustic events within the audio.

repos.name: quantskills
repos.description: QuantSkills组织的全景导航 ——Panoramic navigator for the QuantSkills organization
repos.summary: This project is a panoramic navigator for the QuantSkills organization, serving as a clickable index for quantitative skills, factors, and agents. It aims to make trading experience, research methods, factor models, and strategy code into standardized assets that can be searched, installed, verified, and shared. The navigator is organized into categories such as data interfaces, factor research tools, market analysis, risk monitoring, and trading tools.

repos.name: conversation-steganography
repos.description: Use LLMs to hide messages inside normal looking conversations
repos.summary: This project hides secret messages within normal-looking conversations. It uses an AI model to disguise encrypted messages as innocent text, allowing private communication through any messaging app without revealing the hidden content. The AI model runs entirely on your device, and the messages are encrypted using strong security methods.

repos.name: open-seo
repos.description: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
repos.summary: OpenSEO is an open-source search engine optimization (SEO) tool that offers an alternative to expensive, complex services. It provides features like keyword research, site audits, and backlink analysis. The tool can also connect with AI agents to help with SEO tasks.

repos.name: codex-keysmith
repos.description: Version-independent Codex instruction deployment with dry-run, backups, hook isolation, and recovery.
repos.summary: `codex-keysmith` is a Python command-line tool that helps manage instructions for Codex, a system for AI models. It allows for the deployment of instruction files, with features like previewing changes before they are made, isolating hooks (pieces of code that can extend functionality), and providing recovery options if something goes wrong. The tool aims to manage these instructions in a way that is independent of specific software versions.

repos.name: ego-lite
repos.description: The best browser for both you and your AI agents work in parallel.
repos.summary: ego lite is a browser designed for both people and AI agents to work together. It allows AI agents to run tasks in their own separate areas within the browser, called Spaces, without interfering with your own browsing. This setup helps tasks finish faster and uses fewer computational resources.

repos.name: Agentlas-OS
repos.description: Agent OS: keep specialist agents in a hub, spin up a temporary orchestrator per task. Local-first, works with any model.
repos.summary: Agentlas OS is a system that allows users to build, borrow, and own specialist AI agents. It keeps these agents organized and can create a temporary orchestrator for specific tasks. This project works with any AI model and is designed to run locally on your computer.

repos.name: Auto-Company
repos.description: An auto-company works for 24/7 on your own PC - Windows/Linux/macOS.
repos.summary: This project creates an autonomous AI company that operates continuously on your computer. It uses multiple AI agents, each acting like an expert, to ideate products, make decisions, write code, deploy software, and market them without human intervention. The system runs in a loop, with agents performing tasks, updating shared memory, and then resting before the next cycle.

repos.name: hyperresearch
repos.description: Agent-driven research knowledge base. Agents collect, search, and synthesize web research into a persistent, searchable wiki.
repos.summary: This project is an agent-driven research knowledge base that collects, searches, and synthesizes web research. It uses agents to create a persistent, searchable wiki from the gathered information. The system aims to produce audited reports with source details and stores all sources in a vault for future sessions.

repos.name: rustwright
repos.description: Playwright's API on a Rust CDP engine — Chromium browser automation for Python & Node, no driver subprocess. (Alpha)
repos.summary: Rustwright is a tool that automates web browsers, specifically Chromium. It allows developers to control browsers from their Python or Node.js code using an API similar to Playwright, but it runs on a native Rust engine instead of relying on a separate driver program. This approach makes it faster and use less memory than traditional methods.

repos.name: ParLaunch
repos.description: The Meme Reserve. The launchpad where you print your own dollar or launch your moonshot on Uniswap or Sushiswap
repos.summary: ParLaunch is a platform where users can create their own digital currencies, called tokens, or launch their own stablecoins, which are digital currencies designed to maintain a stable value. It allows users to launch tokens on decentralized exchanges like Uniswap or SushiSwap and create stablecoins that are backed by another digital currency called USDG. All fees generated by the platform are used to buy and permanently remove a specific token, $PAR, from circulation.

repos.name: incremental
repos.description: A library for incremental computations
repos.summary: This project is a library for incremental computations. It allows for building complex calculations that can efficiently update when their inputs change. This can be helpful for applications like spreadsheets that need to react to new data, or for creating views in graphical interfaces that can incorporate new information smoothly.

repos.name: pi-web
repos.description: Web UI for the pi coding agent
repos.summary: This project provides a web-based interface for a coding agent. It allows users to browse past coding sessions, manage models and skills, and preview project files directly in their browser. The interface also displays session details like context usage and costs.

repos.name: solana-mcp-vybe
repos.description: Public Solana MCP registry metadata for Vybe Solana API
repos.summary: This project provides public metadata for the Vybe Solana API. It allows tools like Cursor and Claude to browse schemas or make live calls to the Solana API through a single public server. This server uses a system called Model Context Protocol (MCP) to manage this interaction.

repos.name: GNM
repos.description: An open ecosystem of parametric human models and perception stacks, starting with GNM Head.
repos.summary: The GNM project is an open ecosystem for creating 3D models of humans. It starts with GNM Head, which is a detailed 3D model of the human head and face. This model allows for precise control over aspects like identity, expressions, and head position, and includes internal anatomy like eyeballs, teeth, and a tongue.

repos.name: awesome-zhuiju-free
repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary: This project is a guide to free, ad-free resources for watching shows and movies. It manually selects resources and checks their availability daily. The guide includes links to online movies, movie apps, cloud drive searches, magnet links, subtitles, TVBox configurations, and live TV sources.

repos.name: solana-swap-api
repos.description: Solana Swap API & Router
repos.summary: This project is a Solana Swap API and Router that helps developers build applications for swapping tokens on the Solana blockchain. It provides tools to get quotes for token exchanges, compare different routing options, and construct unsigned transactions for swaps. This can be used as a starting point for creating user interfaces for token swaps, integrating with cryptocurrency wallets, or building automated trading applications.

repos.name: personal-model
repos.description: Build your HUMAN.md.
repos.summary: Persome is an open-source project that builds a "Personal Model" by learning how you think and work from your activity on a Mac. It provides this model as context to other AI clients, like Codex and Claude Code, to help them continue your work and make decisions based on your patterns. This model runs locally on your Mac and is designed to be private by default.

repos.name: gridex
repos.description: A native macOS / windows / Linux database IDE built with Swift and AppKit. Connect to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and Redis from a single app with a fast, keyboard-driven interface.
repos.summary: Gridex is a database tool that runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It allows users to connect to various databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and Redis from a single application. The tool also includes AI chat capabilities that can understand database schemas and write queries.

repos.name: scroll-world
repos.description: A skill that turn any brand into a scrollable 3D world
repos.summary: This project creates a scrollable 3D world landing page for any brand or industry. As you scroll, a camera flies through different scenes without any cuts, creating a continuous journey. It generates the necessary art and video assets, then wires them up with a scroll engine that plays the entire sequence as one flight.

repos.name: depth-anything.cpp
repos.description: A from-scratch C++17/ggml port of Depth Anything 3 (ByteDance)
repos.summary: This project is a C++ implementation of the Depth Anything 3 model, designed for estimating depth and camera pose from single images. It provides a self-contained library that can output a dense depth map, per-pixel confidence, and camera calibration information. The project aims to offer a fast and efficient way to perform these calculations without requiring Python or specialized graphics hardware.

repos.name: Pekingman
repos.summary: Pekingman is a system designed for virtual characters that can perceive their surroundings, remember past interactions, reason like humans, and respond in real-time. It connects sensing, memory, reasoning, emotion, and action into a continuous loop to create believable and consistent behavior for virtual characters in interactive scenarios. This system is useful for virtual NPCs, digital humans, and simulation games.

repos.name: cue
repos.description: Open-source macOS AI copilot that floats over your screen, sees/hears your meetings, and stays hidden from screen shares. Cluely alternative, bring-your-own-key.
repos.summary: This project is an open-source AI copilot for macOS that can see your screen and hear your meetings. It floats over other applications and can assist with tasks like solving coding problems or suggesting what to say in a conversation. The tool is designed to remain hidden from screen shares, acting as a private assistant.

repos.name: gloomberb
repos.description: Finance terminal, in your terminal.
repos.summary: Gloomberb is an open-source finance terminal that runs in your computer's command line interface (CLI). It allows users to research companies, track markets, and manage portfolios. Gloomberb is available as a desktop application for macOS and Windows, and as a terminal-based interface for macOS, Linux, and Windows.

repos.name: jiuwenswarm
repos.description: JiuwenSwarm is an intelligent AI Agent built on openJiuwen. It extends the powerful capabilities of large language models directly to your fingertips through various communication apps you use daily.
repos.summary: JiuwenSwarm is an AI Agent system that enables multiple AI agents to work together on complex tasks. It allows users to control these agents using natural language, and the agents can learn and improve their abilities over time. JiuwenSwarm can also coordinate with other agents across different machines and integrate with common communication applications.

repos.name: Three.js-Object-Sculptor-Codex-Plugin
repos.description: Codex plugin that turns attached object images into code-only, animation-ready procedural Three.js models.
repos.summary: This project is a plugin for Codex that transforms images of objects into code that creates 3D models using Three.js, a JavaScript library for creating and displaying animated 3D computer graphics in a web browser. It guides the process of rebuilding the object from the image into a code-only model that is ready for animation.

repos.name: cuelume
repos.description: Cuelume is a curated sound palette, not an audio engine. It gives buttons, links, toggles, and completed actions clear feedback without asking developers to design sounds themselves. Add an attribute, call bind(), done.
repos.summary: Cuelume is a collection of fourteen carefully designed interaction sounds for the web. It provides clear feedback for buttons, links, and toggles without requiring developers to create their own sounds. These sounds are synthesized live using the Web Audio API and have no external dependencies.

repos.name: OmniRoute
repos.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 268+ providers (50+ free), 500+ models — Kimi, Claude, GPT, OpenAI, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 500+ contributors
repos.summary: OmniRoute is a free AI gateway that connects to over 268 different AI providers, offering access to more than 500 models. It works with various coding tools and provides a single endpoint to access these AI services. The project aims to prevent users from hitting limits by automatically switching between providers and uses compression techniques to save tokens.

repos.name: wardrobe
repos.description: Your clothes, extracted and organized with gpt-image.
repos.summary: This project helps you organize your clothes by extracting them from photos. It uses AI to detect and cut out garments, creating modeled photos of them. You can then use it to generate outfit ideas from your wardrobe.

repos.name: rift
repos.summary: This project, called rift, is an experimental tool that offers a better alternative to git worktrees. It works by using copy-on-write technology to save space and create new workspaces almost instantly. Rift can be used as a command-line tool or as a library with JavaScript environments like Bun or Node.js, and it currently supports macOS and Linux with specific file system features.

repos.name: ditto.site
repos.summary: Ditto.site is a tool that takes a public website address and turns it into a self-contained application. It captures what a website looks like in a browser and then creates a new project, typically using Next.js or Vite React. This process generates code from the rendered website, not from its original source files.

repos.name: jellium-desktop
repos.description: An unofficial desktop client for Jellyfin
repos.summary: Jellium Desktop is an unofficial application that allows users to access Jellyfin, a media server, from their desktop computers. It is built using other software components called CEF and mpv.

repos.name: sakuramedia
repos.description: 面向 NAS 用户的全平台、聚焦观影与自动化的核心需求，打造一站式Jav观影中枢。
repos.summary: SakuraMedia is a platform for users with Network Attached Storage (NAS) devices to manage and watch video content. It offers a centralized hub for discovering, subscribing to, and automatically downloading videos, with features like information translation and scene similarity search. The project is developed using Flutter, providing support across multiple platforms including desktop and mobile applications.

repos.name: muscriptor
repos.description: MuScriptor is a multi-instrument music transcription model developed by Kyutai and Mirelo.
repos.summary: MuScriptor is a music transcription model that converts audio into musical notes. It can process songs with multiple instruments, having been trained on a large dataset ranging from classical to heavy metal music. The project offers both a command-line interface and a web-based interface for users to transcribe audio files.

repos.name: LiveAgent
repos.description: A fully functional AI Agent desktop client that supports Webui access and can be creatively customized and expanded!
repos.summary: LiveAgent is a desktop application that acts as an AI agent. It allows AI to interact with your computer by reading and writing files, running commands, and managing tasks. It also supports remote access through a web interface.

repos.name: FluxDown
repos.description: Rust 驱动的多协议下载管理器，支持 HTTP/FTP/BitTorrent 磁力链接及 HLS/DASH 流媒体，智能多线程加速与浏览器无缝集成。精美界面，极致性能，永久免费，零广告。
repos.summary: FluxDown is a download manager that supports various protocols like HTTP, FTP, and BitTorrent. It also handles streaming media formats such as HLS and DASH. The project uses smart multi-threading to speed up downloads and integrates with web browsers.

repos.name: maka-agent
repos.description: Maka — local-first AI desktop assistant
repos.summary: Maka is a desktop assistant that works locally on your machine. It can inspect projects, run tools, and create outputs, with its operations and progress saved as recoverable facts. Maka is available as a desktop application, a terminal interface, and a non-interactive command-line tool.

repos.name: kimi-code
repos.description: Kimi Code CLI  —  The Starting Point for Next-Gen Agents
repos.summary: Kimi Code CLI is an AI coding assistant that operates within your terminal. It can read and modify code, execute commands, search files, and retrieve web pages. This tool uses feedback to decide its next action and works with Kimi models, but can also be set up with other compatible services.

repos.name: yupi-hot-monitor
repos.description: 2026 年编程导航 AI 编程实战新项目，基于 Node.js + Express + React + OpenRouter 的 AI 热点监控工具，支持多信息源聚合抓取（Twitter / Bing / HackerNews / B 站等 7+ 平台）、AI 查询扩展、AI 真假识别与相关性分析、WebSocket 实时推送、邮件通知、多维度筛选排序，并将热点监控能力封装为 Agent Skills 技能包。覆盖 Prisma + SQLite 数据库、Socket.io 实时通信、Axios + Cheerio 网页爬虫、OpenRouter 大模型接入、Aceternity UI 炫酷前端、node-cron 定时任务、VSCode Copilot Vibe Coding + MCP
repos.summary: This project is an AI-powered tool that monitors trending topics. It gathers information from over eight different sources, such as Twitter and Bilibili, and uses artificial intelligence to analyze the content for authenticity and relevance. The tool then notifies users of important hot topics through real-time updates and email alerts.

repos.name: chinese-poetry-api
repos.description: 📜 诗泉：高性能中国古诗词 API 服务
repos.summary: This project is a high-performance API service for Chinese classical poetry. It provides access to a large collection of poems, including Tang poems, Song lyrics, and Yuan qu, and supports searching by title, content, or author. The service offers both REST and GraphQL interfaces and can provide results in simplified or traditional Chinese.

repos.name: mimic
repos.description: Intercept any app, then call it from Python like a library
repos.summary: This project intercepts an app's communication and allows you to interact with it from Python as if it were a library. It works by capturing authentication details from your app's traffic, then an AI generates a Python client based on that captured information. This generated client provides named methods and templates for making requests, enabling you to call the app's functions programmatically.

repos.name: codex-auth-helper
repos.description: Codex登陆助手：安全地在本地导出您的已登录 ChatGPT 会话配置，生成符合 Codex 规范的 auth.json 本地备份文件。
repos.summary: Codex 认证助手 is a Chrome extension that helps developers manage their login credentials for ChatGPT. It securely exports your logged-in ChatGPT session configuration locally and generates an `auth.json` file that meets Codex specifications. This process is done entirely offline, ensuring your privacy.

repos.name: grok-build
repos.description: SpaceXAI's coding agent harness and TUI. Fullscreen, mouse interactive, extensible.
repos.summary: Grok Build is an AI coding agent that runs in a full-screen terminal interface. It can understand codebases, edit files, run commands, and search the web. It can be used interactively or for automated tasks.

repos.name: Ontology-Playground
repos.description: Free, open-source web app for learning about ontologies and Microsoft Fabric IQ. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies, design your own visually, export as RDF/XML, and share interactive diagrams. Zero backend, fully static.
repos.summary: Ontology Playground is a free, open-source web application that helps users learn about ontologies, which are ways of organizing knowledge. It allows users to explore pre-built ontologies, design their own visually, and export them in a specific format. The application also provides interactive diagrams and a learning hub with courses and quizzes.

repos.name: Aether
repos.summary: Aether is a program designed to help people access the internet on networks that block or restrict access. It finds ways to connect, creates a secure, hidden path for your internet traffic, and then makes a local proxy available for your applications to use. This allows you to bypass common internet restrictions.

repos.name: reflect-open
repos.description: Open-source Reflect rewrite: A local-first AI agent-friendly Markdown note-taking app
repos.summary: Reflect is a note-taking application that uses plain Markdown files. It allows users to create daily notes, link ideas together using wiki-style links, and search their notes locally. The app can also optionally connect to AI services to answer questions based on the user's notes.

repos.name: little-book-rl
repos.description: The Little Book of Reinforcement Learning
repos.summary: This project is the GitHub page for "The Little Book of Reinforcement Learning." It provides a short introduction to Reinforcement Learning, covering basic concepts and applied algorithms. The repository also includes supplementary materials, such as PyTorch implementations of algorithms and detailed explanations with proofs for dynamic programming methods.

The book is built using a tool called mdBook and is available under open-source licenses.

repos.name: ossie
repos.description: Apache Ossie, industry wide specification effort to standardize how we exchange semantic metadata across analytics, AI and BI platforms, providing a vendor neutral, single source of truth for semantic data
repos.summary: Apache Ossie is an effort to create a standard way to share information about data, called semantic metadata, across different analytics, AI, and business intelligence tools. It provides a single, consistent definition for data that can be understood by any tool, preventing confusion and ensuring that data meanings remain the same no matter where they are used. This helps avoid problems like the same key performance indicator being defined differently in various systems.

repos.name: FckSignups
repos.description: A list of tools that are open-source, in-browser, and require no-signups!
repos.summary: This project is a collection of open-source tools that can be used directly in a web browser without requiring any sign-ups or accounts. It aims to provide tools that work immediately, respect user privacy by not tracking data, and are simple to use. The project is built using React and TypeScript and is organized into various categories like productivity, design, and development.

repos.name: loopy
repos.description: A library of practical AI-agent loops and an installable skill for finding, adapting, and designing repeatable agent workflows.
repos.summary: This project provides a library of practical AI agent workflows, called "loops," and an installable tool called "Loopy" that helps AI agents find, adapt, and design these repeatable workflows. The library includes a public website where users can browse and copy prompts, and Loopy acts as a companion to assist agents in discovering, auditing, crafting, and running these loops. Each loop guides an AI agent through a task by defining its goal, how to check progress, the next steps, and when to stop.

repos.name: OfficeCLI
repos.description: OfficeCLI is the first and best Office suite  purpose-built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files. Free, open-source, single binary, no Office installation required.
repos.summary: OfficeCLI is a tool designed for AI agents to interact with Microsoft Office files. It allows AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents without needing to install Microsoft Office. The project includes a rendering engine that helps AI agents "see" documents by converting them into formats like HTML or PNG.

repos.name: Minari
repos.description: A standard format for offline reinforcement learning datasets, with popular reference datasets and related utilities
repos.summary: Minari is a Python library that provides a standard format for datasets used in offline reinforcement learning, which is a type of machine learning where an agent learns from pre-collected data. It offers popular reference datasets and tools to help researchers work with this data. The library allows users to list, download, and read these datasets, as well as create their own.

repos.name: Cowart
repos.summary: Cowart is a plugin for Codex that provides a visual canvas for creative work. It allows users to brainstorm ideas, add annotations to images, generate new images based on prompts and reference images, and create interactive HTML presentations. The canvas and its assets are saved directly within the user's project directory.

repos.name: pi-computer-use
repos.description: Let Pi control your apps on MacOS & Windows
repos.summary: This project allows AI agents to control applications on macOS and Windows computers. It enables agents to see what is on an app's screen, understand its elements, and perform actions like clicking, typing, and scrolling. This is helpful when an AI needs to interact with a regular desktop application rather than using specialized programming interfaces.

repos.name: scipilot-figure-skill
repos.description: SciPilot Skills family - Publication-grade scientific figure copilot for Claude Code
repos.summary: This project acts as a scientific data visualization advisor. It first analyzes your data and recommends the most suitable chart to convey your intended argument. Then, it generates the figure at a quality suitable for academic publications, ensuring proper formatting and even checking for visual errors after rendering.

repos.name: kairos
repos.description: Official code for world model Kairos
repos.summary: Kairos is a world model designed for unified understanding, generation, and action prediction. It learns from various data sources, including general videos, human behavior, and real-robot interactions, to build persistent representations of the world. Kairos jointly predicts future visual states and executable robot actions, enabling long-horizon reasoning and generation for embodied artificial intelligence.

repos.name: autoremesher
repos.description: Automatic quad remeshing tool
repos.summary: AutoRemesher is a tool that automatically converts complex 3D shapes, called high-polygon meshes, into simpler shapes made of four-sided polygons, known as quad-based topology. This process is called quad remeshing. It helps create cleaner digital models.

repos.name: insane-search
repos.description: Auto-bypass for blocked websites in Claude Code — Phase 0→3 adaptive scheduler, no API keys
repos.summary: This project is a tool that helps Claude Code access blocked websites. It works by trying different methods to get to public information, starting with simple approaches and escalating to more complex ones like using a real browser if needed. This allows Claude Code to retrieve content from sites that would normally be inaccessible without requiring any API keys or special setup.

repos.name: OpenSuperWhisper
repos.description: macOS dictation app
repos.summary: OpenSuperWhisper is a macOS application that records and transcribes audio in real-time. It uses transcription engines called Whisper and Parakeet, and allows users to download models directly within the app. The application supports various input methods like keyboard shortcuts and mouse buttons, and can transcribe audio files by dragging and dropping them.

repos.name: ORG2
repos.description: Coding agent orgs: built for reviewability and team collaboration. Built-in rust harness & 20+ CLIs.
repos.summary: ORG-II is an open-source agent IDE built for reviewability and team collaboration. It allows users to manage and review agent sessions, trace code changes back to specific agent actions, and collaborate with others on shared projects. The project aims to provide a structured environment for humans and AI agents to work together effectively.

repos.name: mattpocock-skills-zh-CN
repos.description: 这是 mattpocock/skills 的简体中文本地化版本。
repos.summary: This project is a simplified Chinese translation of the `mattpocock/skills` project. It aims to better adapt to Chinese large language models and be more convenient for native Chinese developers. The project translates documentation and skill descriptions while keeping technical elements like directory names and commands unchanged to ensure functionality.

repos.name: agent-native
repos.description: A framework for building agent-native applications.
repos.summary: Agent-Native is a framework for building applications that have agents at their core. It allows developers to define actions once and use them across different parts of an application, such as the user interface, agents, or command-line tools. The framework also includes an agent runtime with features like memory and tools, and it can connect to various databases and hosting environments.

repos.name: CPA-Manager-Plus
repos.description: A self-hosted CPA / CLIProxyAPI management panel and observability dashboard for requests, usage, cost, quota, failures, and account health.
repos.summary: CPA Manager Plus is a self-hosted tool that monitors AI gateways. It tracks requests, costs, failures, and account health for systems like CPA and OpenAI-compatible gateways. This allows users to manage providers, credentials, and configurations while keeping a history of requests and cost analysis locally.

repos.name: mesh-llm
repos.description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.
repos.summary: This project pools computing resources like GPUs and memory from multiple machines to power AI models, specifically large language models (LLMs). It makes these combined resources available through an API that acts like one from OpenAI, allowing users to run AI agents and chat applications. The system can distribute models across different machines, even splitting large models into stages to run on multiple boxes.

repos.name: codex-claude-academic-skills
repos.description: 本仓库包含三个面向学术科研人员的Skills，覆盖从文献阅读、论文写作到科学计算的完整研究工作流。office-academic-skill 负责论文阅读报告与学术 PPT/Word 文档生成；research-writing-skill 提供论文写作、润色与审稿回复辅助；scientific-toolkit-skill 整合 MATLAB/Python 科学计算与期刊级图表生成。三个 Skill 专为中文科研用户设计，可在 Claude Code 和 codex 中一键调用。
repos.summary: This project provides three tools for academic researchers, covering the entire research process from reading papers to writing and scientific computing. One tool helps generate reports from literature and academic documents like Word and PowerPoint presentations. Another assists with writing, refining, and responding to reviews for academic papers. The third tool integrates scientific calculations using MATLAB or Python and generates publication-quality charts. These tools are designed for Chinese researchers and can be used with Claude Code and Codex.
